The row ⋯'s accessible name: E18-D02 gives none, and CMP-002's label is mandatory (`15` L62); E11-D04 names SCR-045's 'Actions for 13:58' (the row's time; E11-D04 L190, L303), so 'Actions for 13:35' would be its analogue, for E18-D05 to key. An icon-only button: no visible text.

The header's [⋯] (sketch L663): §7 gives it no name and no action; E11-D04's actions-column header ⋯ opens the column picker (E11-D04 L221), and the panel's own controls are E25-D02's (§1.2 L111-112). Drawn as sketched, without behaviour.

live_checks: No inst node on this board: every control is a composition (kit 'compose'), so no library set, variant prop or text layer needs verifying.
Glyphs: ▲ ▼ × in type.ui.label (Inter) and the en dash – in type.num.sm (JetBrains Mono) render, no fallback box.

Icons: icon/check (color.text.primary) in the checked box and icon/more-horizontal × 3 (color.text.secondary: the header's and the two rows', each centred in a 24 × 24 CMP-002 IconButton composition) bind as the registry glyphs.

After relayout: the header and both rows are 1,264 px wide with no padding of their own, cells 111 / 270 / 302 / 159 / 127 / 255 / 40 px, each data cell padded 8 px each side (space.inset.sm); the three 24 × 24 IconButtons centre in the last column, 8 px inside the panel's inner right edge; the panel's padding reads 8 px (space.inset.sm).
Price range and Max ratio headers and values end at their cells' right padding (justify end); Time, Side and depth, Age and Status start at their left padding.

One line each inside the 24 px rows: 'Active, forming' (type.ui.body-strong), '▼ SELL stack ×4' (type.ui.label) and '64,031.0–64,034.9' (type.num.sm) in their cells; no header label (type.ui.label) wraps.

The filter row: the caption (type.ui.caption) at the panel's inner right edge (justify space-between), centred on the 24 px checkbox row; the panel's 1 px light-grey edge shows on all four sides inside the frame's clip.
'Active, forming' (type.ui.body-strong) reads heavier than 'Tested' (type.ui.body) at scale 1: weight is the status's second carrier (L678).
Board height: the root reads ≤ 1,660 px after relayout (est. 1,599 px); board 17's slot starts at y 5,100, directly below.

deviations: The SCR-056 panel is drawn maximised in the 1280 × 800 frame (1,280 × 800), as §3 L177 draws SCR-030's chart panel: §0 L30-32 and §7 give the frame size and 'a neutral panel frame' (§0 L54; L661; §1.2 L110) but no panel size, and a docked workspace narrows it. With two rows shown the panel is empty below the E25-D02 band. The locate target, a BTCUSDT 5m SCR-030 pane, is taken as open behind the panel (the State block), so every row locates and §7.3's shared reason under the caption (L704-705) is not drawn; board 51 draws it.

Column widths: §7 gives the columns, not their widths (the kit's COLS_056 note). The kit's 616 px of data columns are about the sketch's proportions (L663); gen_12.py fit_columns() scales them × 1.987 to 111 / 270 / 302 / 159 / 127 / 255 px so the table spans the panel's 1,264 px inner width (no header or row padding, compact_table()) with the kit's 40 px [⋯] column at its right edge, as the sketch draws it (L663-665), board 13's rule; the kit's builder keeps 656 px of columns in any width.

Compact follows one rule over the whole table, E11-D04 §2's compact column for its CMP-049 table (E11-D04 L97-101; E11-D02 D6, §6 L217, steps the chrome the same way): a 24 px header, rows and checkbox (size.row.compact, `16` §3 L113); type.num.sm numbers (Time, Price range, Max ratio, Age, L99); type.ui.label header labels, side words and checkbox label and a type.ui.caption caption (L100: type.ui.caption 11 / type.ui.label 12; the kit's compact types, kept); 8 px padding each side of every data cell (L98 `space.2` 8, bound as space.inset.sm) and none on the header and rows (gen_12.py compact_table(): the kit pads 4 px per cell inside 8 px per row at both densities); the 40 px [⋯] column holds E11-D04's 24 × 24 action button (L101), 8 px each side. The title and the E25-D02 band (a placeholder, not table copy) keep the kit's type. Board 13 draws the same frame by the comfortable column.

The status words keep the kit's type.ui.body-strong ('Active, forming') and type.ui.body ('Tested'), 13 px beside compact's 12 px labels and 11 px numbers: 'Active in semibold; Tested in regular' (§7.1 L678) needs a same-size weight pair, and the token set's only one is body-strong / body (type.ui.label is 12 px medium with no regular twin; type.ui.caption is 11 px regular). The word carries the state; the weight is its second carrier (the kit's 'semibold' deviation).

The panel's padding is E11-D04 §2's compact panel inset, 8 px (L98 `space.2` 8, bound as space.inset.sm; `16` §3 L113's compact step): the kit pads its panel space.panel.padding (12) at both densities. The filter row, the table and the E25-D02 band span the 1,264 px inner width (gen_12.py compact_panel()).

The header's [⋯] (sketch L663) is drawn as the rows' ⋯: the more-horizontal glyph in the dark grey in a 24 × 24 CMP-002 IconButton composition centred in the row-menu column (gen_12.py header_menu() and icon_buttons()); the kit's header leaves that cell empty. §7 gives it no name and no action (copy gaps).

Each ⋯ is a CMP-002 IconButton composition, 24 × 24 (E11-D04 L101: compact action buttons, size.target.min; `15` L61: 'icon-only affordance (… row actions)'), its glyph centred, no fill or edge at rest, centred in the 40 px row-menu column (8 px each side, the column unpadded): the kit draws a bare CMP-019 glyph.

Price range and Max ratio, header and values, are end-aligned in their cells (gen_12.py align_numbers()): prices and percentages are 'right-aligned in tables' (`15` §0.3 rule 6, L40; E11-D04 D4 L117, L225); Time, Side and depth, Age and Status keep the start, as the sketch's columns do (L663-665). The kit's imbalance_table() aligns every cell to the start (a kit-owner change for the other SCR-056 boards).

The 13:05 ▲ BUY stack ×5 row (L666, '(… Broken: hidden)') is not drawn: 'Only unfilled (hide broken)' hides it (§7.2 L689); the caption counts it (L690-691) and the State block names it. A broken row's look (regular weight, the row's text in secondary emphasis, L678-679) is board 49's.
'(neutral panel frame)' (§0 L54; sketch L661) is the label for the frame, not UI copy: it is drawn as the panel's neutral chrome (a 1 px light-grey edge on the paper) and named in the annotation.
The kit names its table node 'CMP-049 table (composition)'; this board renames it 'CMP-049 Table (composition)', `15` L494's name (kit imbalance_table(): a kit-owner change for the other boards).
Every control, chip, button, field, menu, tooltip, drawer and dialog is a composition named '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)': the wireframes are greys only and cvsheet v1 cannot recolour an instance.
'Active in semibold' (§7.1 L678) is drawn in type.ui.body-strong (medium): no semibold 13 px token exists; the word carries the state.

Frames are named as §0 names them ('SCR-030/fp-anatomy'), and cvsheet splits section paths on '/', so frame() names the node with U+2215 '∕' for '/' while sections address inside it; the live renderer renames each frame to its §0 name after the board's last section (live check).
